title: A Autopsy for the Witness
author: Xanthe Thackeray
blurb: Yara Vane, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
